name: self_v1
note: The first-person self-description the ten legacy runs were built from, sentence for sentence. Sentences are alternatives in priority order: an exact age over a band, the employment/income block degrades to whichever answer exists, and a sentence whose column the dataset lacks or whose answer is non-substantive is dropped. Filters carry the grammar (years, in, have) from the cs language pack. Over the survey it reproduces the legacy prompts on 3880 of 3880 rows; over the grid it yields the three sentences the grid has columns for. Changing any wording here means a new variant file, not an edit.
sentences: Žiji {region|in}, v okresu {district} a obci o velikosti {town_size}.
Z hlediska zaměstnání jsem {employment_status} a příjem naší domácnosti je {income_range}.
